items.question: What services does MMI ENGINEERING offer?
items.answer: We provide plumbing, electrical, AC & appliance repair, painting, cleaning and general home maintenance services in Singapore.

items.question: How do I book a service?
items.answer: The quickest way is to message us on WhatsApp at +65 8587 8190. You can also use the contact form and we will get back to you.

items.question: What are your working hours?
items.answer: We are available Monday to Sunday, 8:00 AM to 12:00 PM.

items.question: Which areas do you serve?
items.answer: We serve customers across Singapore. Message us your address and we will confirm availability.

items.question: Do you offer a service guarantee?
items.answer: Yes. Every job is backed by our satisfaction guarantee. If something is not right, let us know and we will make it right.

items.question: How do I get a quote?
items.answer: Send us a short description (and photos if you can) on WhatsApp or through the contact form, and we will reply with a quote.
